column12: NG LGA/Health Facility Tuberculosis Central Register
column13:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme NTBLCP/TB 08 Local Government Area/Health Facility Tuberculosis
Central Register. One model instance represents a TB central register and
contains repeatable patient entries covering registration, treatment
initiation, disease classification, referral, bacteriological monitoring,
treatment outcome and TB/HIV activities.
Identifier assigned to the LGA/Health Facility TB Central Register or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the health facility or LGA TB service maintaining the register, when available.
One longitudinal patient row spanning the left and right pages of the NTBLCP/TB 08 register.
